prior: Y-NCI08 retained only seven uncompressed links and scored 96/192 against two independent unknown-future four-edge queries, versus full exact 12-edge oracle 192/192. Necessity of eight original edge records falsifies uncompressed memory, not all forms of latent path compression.
hypothesis: Can an explicitly coded online two-hop path compressor embedded in the same 576-byte native Yggdrasil StatePool, using unchanged learned admission and graph-local retention plus learned edge join, preserve both four-hop chains with seven active memory entries and recover across checkpoint?
freeze: Compression solely when two currently observed adjacent span-one edges exist, creating a one-slot span-two path with endpoints and span count encoded in existing spare native StatePool channels. Never train compress trigger or inspect future queries. Preserve original pretrained Torch graph-local policy 4 weights and learned join 6 weights. Retain at most seven chunks with existing graph-local scorer when overflow occurs. Compare unchanged seven-original-edge graph-local NCI08 baseline and 12-edge unconstrained oracle, new sealed 30208..30231 ×4 existing ordering families, 96 states/192 questions; no reuse of original NCI08 29248..29271.
criteria: CODED_TWO_LINK_COMPRESSION_RESTORES_BOUNDED_RECALL iff full oracle scores 100%, each native state <=7 chunks and <=14 represented original links, compressed paired score >=75%, and gain >=15 points over frozen uncompressed graph policy. PARTIAL_TWO_LINK_CHUNK_RECALL_GAIN if gain>=5 points. Else NO_TWO_LINK_CHUNK_COMPOSITION_GAIN. Check original record-level scores and exact original first-use once-only.
resources: Same physical 576-byte StatePool per arm, native seven active slots. The compressor uses 6 instead of original 3 channels per slot (all within 16), and explicit span-aware programmed graph traversal instead of unchanged 4-step search; report per-query learned join evaluations, merge counts and graph scorer multiplies. This is not equal compute or independently learned path formation.
limits: Programmed compression and exact span arithmetic are NOT neural learned relational storage, learned semantic abstraction or AGI/RSI; families use NCI08 grammar with fresh seeds, not general novelty of grammar.
controls: No task target/query revealed before native retention, no external LLM
Frozen models and prior sources; static dev smoke can use fabricated two-edge fixture only
Preregister source, custody of one prospective first-use before interpretation, one final full pytest and independent read-only reaggregation
No FORGE, CKB/KTRADE, accepted refs, merges or production
